prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Generate one polished, high fidelity FULL DESKTOP WEBSITE PAGE concept for the Lithuanian beauty booking platform madbeauty.lt, showing the /paslaugos category directory. This is a new design concept, not a browser screenshot. Output a crisp large portrait page, about 1600px wide and 2300px tall. Show the entire page from header to footer, front-on, no laptop, no perspective, no device frame.

Established identity: madbeauty. black bold lowercase wordmark with a small violet dot; black #111114, white #FFFFFF, violet #7040E8, very pale violet #F1EDFF. DM Sans-like typography, proper Lithuanian diacritics. Modern, refined, memorable beauty editorial catalogue; restrained palette; excellent legible hierarchy and balanced spacing. White dominant, near-black headings, purple used for actions and selected details, never giant purple headings everywhere.

Header: white, slim. Left "madbeauty." right navigation "Paslaugos", "Kaip veikia", "Grožio idėjos", "Meistrams", and outlined account button "Paskyra". Active Paslaugos subtle purple underline.
Main generous 80px side gutters. Breadcrumb "Pradžia / Paslaugos".
Hero layout: confident large black heading "Grožio paslaugos"; one sentence "Rinkis savo grožio ritualą. Atrask paslaugą savo mieste." Compact right-side original sweeping violet line-art beauty tools composition, visually sophisticated, not stock female face silhouette. Hero occupies only about 280px. Under heading a functional-looking horizontal search field with small magnifier, placeholder "Kokios paslaugos ieškai?", right purple button "Ieškoti". 
Section title "Atrask pagal kategoriją", understated secondary text "Nuo kasdienės priežiūros iki ypatingos progos."

Design an illustrated service atlas with ALL FOURTEEN categories below, exactly once each, no invented provider counts, ratings, prices, badges or availability. Four-column directory on desktop. First three rows four cards, final row two wider cards: 14 total. Cards are relatively compact, about 245px tall, subtle pale border, 16px corners, no heavy shadow, ample negative space. Each card top has a distinctive professionally drawn ORIGINAL TWO-TONE VECTOR-STYLE illustration with fine near-black linework and restrained violet solid accents. These illustrations must have consistent editorial drawing language and meaningful recognizable subjects, not emoji, generic circle icons, 3D balloons or photo collages. Each card lower area has a black category title, subdued readable short service examples, and a small violet diagonal arrow. Long titles wrap gracefully. Slight alternating white and almost-white lilac illustration panels. Make categories feel curated, recognizable at a glance, easy to scan, not a wall of purple links.

Exact category order, title / subtitle / illustration concept:
1. "Plaukai" / "Kirpimas · Dažymas · Šukuosenos" / graceful scissors with comb and a flowing lock of hair.
2. "Nagai" / "Manikiūras · Pedikiūras · Lakavimas" / elegant hand with manicured nails and small polish bottle.
3. "Antakiai" / "Korekcija · Dažymas · Laminavimas" / close cropped eyebrow and fine brow brush, distinctive from eyelashes.
4. "Blakstienos" / "Priauginimas · Laminavimas · Dažymas" / delicately closed eye with curved lashes and lash wand.
5. "Makiažas" / "Dieninis · Vakarinis · Mokymai" / powder compact with makeup brush and lipstick.
6. "Depiliacija" / "Vašku · Cukrumi · Aparatu" / waxing spatula over wax pot with restrained flowing curved wax stroke.
7. "Veido priežiūra" / "Valymas · Drėkinimas · Šveitimas" / serum dropper bottle, small facial treatment brush.
8. "Kūno priežiūra" / "Šveitimas · Įvyniojimai · Įdegis" / lotion pump bottle with graceful abstract torso curve, nonsexual.
9. "Masažas" / "Atpalaiduojantis · Veido · Specialus" / two expressive massage hands and a single smooth stone.
10. "SPA ir poilsis" / "Ritualai · Pirtys · Vanduo" / stacked stones, folded towel and small water ripple.
11. "Ilgalaikis makiažas" / "Pigmentavimas · Korekcija" / precision pigment pen with tiny ink cup, clearly different from makeup brushes.
12. "Tatuiruotės" / "Tatuiravimas · Konsultacijos" / tasteful tattoo machine and original simple floral tattoo sketch.
13. "Auskarų vėrimas" / "Vėrimas · Priežiūra" / elegant ear outline with two small hoop earrings.
14. "Estetinės procedūros" / "Konsultacijos · Procedūros" / minimal aesthetic treatment device with clean facial contour, no medical promises.

Below directory one quiet horizontal lilac help strip: heading "Dar nežinai, ką pasirinkti?" short text "Susipažink su procedūromis ir pasiruošk savo vizitui." text link "Skaityti grožio gidus →".
Footer: near-black narrow but complete. Left madbeauty. white wordmark and "Grožio laikas. Tavo ritmu." Three link columns "Klientams", "Meistrams", "Informacija"; relevant existing links e.g. Paslaugos, Grožio idėjos, Kaip pradėti, Privatumas, Taisyklės, Kontaktai. Bottom subtle © 2026 Madbeauty. Small discreet "Dizaino koncepcija" caption.

Constraints: this must look like a professionally art-directed real product website with sharp interface typography and crisp vector-style illustrations; not a presentation poster. Retain all 14 categories, no duplicates or missing categories. No fake salons or testimonials. All visible text Lithuanian, except brand. No giant whitespace between repetitive cards, no saturated full-page gradient, no stock beauty logos, no heavy decorative blobs. Main job is stylish service discovery.
